explanation: Uses WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to parse the HTML with proper structure awareness, then iterates through every token with next_token(). For each token, if it's a SPAN tag (either opener or closer), we skip it with continue. All other tokens—text nodes, other tags, etc.—are serialized with serialize_token(), which produces normalized output. The processor automatically handles attribute normalization, tag closure, encoding, etc.
